arguments.text: 6000 m race, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. After the hard start, hold effort near critical power (pod about 176-182 W shaft, boat about 119 W) through legs 1-5; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above about 0.3 until 1000 m left. Final push: start finish at about 800-1000 m left if pod reserve is above 0.4, else 500 m. Compare legs in same direction (legs()) to separate current from paddler. Watch for drag changes (push_local falls on both directions, rudder weed), pod vs boat power disagreeing (instrument drift), radio course changes. Cue sparingly (20 max, 60 s apart).
Good start. Settle now, long strong strokes at race pace.

arguments.message: Shaft power over 108 percent of critical power for a minute
Boat slower than pod power and fitted current imply: possible weed, drag or instrument issue

arguments.reason: Check effort has settled near critical power after the start

text: Cued ease to settle after the hard start (pod reserve already 77 percent at 1 min); set plan, three watches (pod reserve low, sustained over critical power, drag change) and a wake-up in 3 min.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, still above race pace. Smooth and steady.

4.0 min: shaft 196 W vs pod CP 176, pod reserve 0.42, boat reserve 25 pct (boat reserve draining faster than pod; trust pod more). First ease cue at 1.1 min only partly followed: pod 206-209 W, rate 70->65. Second ease cue at 4.0 min. Leg 1 (north) push about -0.2 to -0.27 m/s against; expect help on leg 2. Target shaft about 178-180 W.

arguments.reason: Check response to second ease cue and leg 2 after the turn
